source.sha256_note: Recorded by the treadmill conversion receipt; size and mtime re-checked, bytes not rehashed.

method.marker_pelvis_tilt: atan2(PSIS mid height - ASIS mid height, horizontal PSIS->ASIS distance); + when PSIS higher (Vicon pelvic tilt definition).
method.marker_thigh: greater trochanter -> mid lateral/medial knee, sagittal angle from straight down, forward positive.
method.marker_shank: mid knee -> mid lateral/medial malleolus, same sign.
method.limits: Trochanter is not the hip joint center, so a few degrees of constant offset is expected. Marker geometry tests sign and recipe, not model calibration.
method.power_check: Least-squares slope and correlation of source power component 1 on moment component 1 x d(angle component 1)/dt, all frames.
